notes.text:
Provisional assessment — fern-renderer

Observed: On 2026-08-01, Fern 1.0 lost transparent PNG pixels in native mode (200 ms); compatibility preserved them (600 ms) [alpha-defect]. On 2026-08-02, Fern 1.0 correctly exported an opaque JPEG in native mode (200 ms); transparency was not retested [opaque-success]. On 2026-08-03, after upgrading to Fern 1.1, the same transparent-PNG test preserved all transparent pixels in both native (200 ms) and compatibility (600 ms) modes [alpha-fixed].

Concluded: The earlier transparency failure was resolved for the tested PNG on version 1.1; native was faster in that test [alpha-fixed]. The opaque JPEG success does not establish transparency correctness [opaque-success]. Version 1.0 findings are historical, not evidence of a current 1.1 defect [alpha-defect, alpha-fixed]. These synthetic local observations do not establish general correctness or performance across files or environments. Latest captured evidence identifies 1.1 as installed as of 2026-08-03; no later verification, opaque-JPEG compatibility comparison, or confidence estimate is available.
